notes: 💰 The bot now tells you when money, not the market, is the reason. “Scanned and bought nothing — nothing met your rules” and “found decisions but couldn’t pay for them” are different truths, and the banner used to collapse both into the first. Now, when decisions exist but free practice cash is reserved by pending orders — or the position cap is full — the banner and the main-screen bot line both say so, name the reason, count the waiting decisions, and confirm they place themselves as orders fill or expire. Discipline still gets called discipline; an empty wallet gets called an empty wallet.
